FullCalendar v6.1.15
====================

This directory must contain the bundled FullCalendar library file:

  index.global.min.js

Download it from:
  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/fullcalendar@6.1.15/index.global.min.js

Place the downloaded file in this directory before deploying the plugin.

WordPress.org guidelines prohibit loading scripts from external CDNs,
so the library must be bundled locally. The file is excluded from the
repository to keep the package size small; run the download script or
add it manually when building a distributable zip.

License: MIT
Project: https://fullcalendar.io/
